❯ 平台跳出來的選單長什麼樣子

⏺ 畫面像這樣，擋住輸入框：

  Teach auto mode about your environment?
  Auto mode works better when it knows your environment. Takes about a minute.
  ❯ 1. Yes
    2. Not now
    3. Don't show again
  Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel

  按 Esc 選單就關了。

✻ Worked for 12s

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
❯ 
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ⏵⏵ auto mode on (shift+tab to cycle)
